_meta.purpose: The last recorded run of this site's own Playwright suite, and the trend across recent runs. Rendered at /tests/.
_meta.note: This describes the previous run, not a live one. A static site cannot execute its own tests on request, and the page says so rather than implying otherwise.
_meta.accepted: Written by a machine on a runner, committed by a person. The workflows upload it as an artifact; nothing pushes it.
_meta.retries: playwright.config.js sets retries to 0, so there is no retry data and therefore no flake rate to publish. /tests/ must not imply one.
_meta.history: Newest first, at most 20 runs. Only runs whose record was committed appear, so gaps are commits nobody accepted a record for.
_meta.empty: No record has been accepted yet. /tests/ renders its empty state from this, and tests/test-report.spec.js holds its content assertions until there is something to assert. The first green run on a runner produces the real one as an artifact; committing that replaces this file wholesale.
